## Hardware Class

Describe the GPU class, count, and measured VRAM.

## Runtime Visibility

Describe ROCm visibility, device enumeration, and any topology caveats.

## Validation Method

Describe the public validation method and commands used when safe to share.

## Result Category

Choose one: pass, conditional pass, needs retest, fail, diagnostic only.

## Redacted Evidence

Attach only redacted logs or screenshots.

## Privacy Check

Confirm that the report does not include private hostnames, private IPs, private paths,
private network details, payment data, participant data, supplier details, or legal
filing details.
